Software Engineer — Remote (US Only)

Experience: 5+ years

Location: United States only

Work Type: Remote

Compensation: $90,000–$110,000/year

Employment: Full-time

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience to join our team in a fully remote role.

Requirements

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

* Strong problem-solving and communication skills

* Experience developing, testing, and maintaining production software

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Location Requirement: Applicants must currently be based in the United States.

Interested candidates can apply at hassanonewaytech@gmail.com
